0022600218.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers (5-6) visit the New York Knicks (6-4) in a matchup of teams heading in opposite directions: Cleveland is 1-4 on the road and has lost two straight, while New York has won four in a row. Cleveland is out Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow), who are averaging 7.8 and 7.7 points per game this season. The Cavaliers trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 109-97 in Cleveland on November 7, and they lost 1-2 to New York in the 2025-26 regular season and 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs.
